data.title: Bipartisan, big tech push for AI regulation comes as Trump claims 'hoax'
data.description: As President Trump dismisses AI fears as a "hoax" akin to past climate scams, tech executives sound the alarm on an "unseen hand" driving AI regulation. Get the latest AI news, warnings on the dangers of AI, and updates on the U.S.-China technology race involving OpenAI, Google AI, Anthropic, and ChatGPT.
